design_status: Follow-up motivated by archived diagnostics; frozen before this fresh campaign. Historical outputs are never used as training checkpoints.
initialization_rule: init_seed = data_seed, identical across weight configurations within an input
observation_rule: Gaussian sigma=noise_level*std(clean field), same saved array and noise draw within case/setting/seed; original state-range clipping retained and measured
model: repository ReactionDiffusionClosure defaults: polynomial residual MLP, width 64, depth 2, positive diffusion parameterization
selection_rule: No default, weight, seed, checkpoint, continuation, or symbolic family is chosen using true closure error. True laws are used only for synthetic generation and evaluation. Every declared configuration and failure is retained.
diagnostics: unweighted and weighted parameter-gradient norm per component
paired common-norm BIR and compression bound
claims: Fixed-budget sensitivity and conditional mechanisms; neither convergence nor a globally optimal weight vector is claimed. OAT does not characterize the full six-weight interaction surface.
